verdict.rationale: Pilot only mentions consolidated reporting for US entities with foreign subsidiaries (pilot-docs-3), with no detail on multi-entity management workflows, intercompany eliminations, or consolidation across multiple domestic entities. No independent/community evidence corroborates this capability in practice. missing for 10: detailed consolidation workflow documentation, support for multiple US entities (not just foreign subsidiaries), intercompany eliminations, hands-on/community validation of multi-entity consolidation.
